name: Modeinspect OG social card by Modeinspect
description: A typography-only social card at roughly 1200×630 built on a single centered axis. A soft vertical gradient — pale lime at the top fading to muted lavender-taupe at the bottom — carries a three-line headline in deep indigo, set very large in a geometric grotesque with tight leading, with the word 'code' swapped into a chunky pixel-style face as the conceptual punchline. The only other element is a small bottom-centered lockup of a cursor glyph with a lime sparkle behind it beside the wordmark, so the headline does all the communicating and the brand stays a quiet footnote.
